scope: V2 document upload/status/list/clear and done.sources rendering
passed_groups: empty: documents before chat show an honest empty state without a list request
upload: pre-chat upload creates one server conversation, uses its ID and reaches Ready
sources: document chunk numbering, score, note text and safe HTTPS links render from done.sources
restore: local history restores source cards and the active document list reloads by server ID
clear: confirmation calls the per-conversation delete endpoint and empties the panel
failure: rejected ingestion becomes Failed without leaving a stale Ready row
narrow: document controls stack below 448px without horizontal overflow or overlap
